NEW GROK BOT!

📸 Picture this: an inventory of all your important stuff done by Grok Bot!

Most people couldn't list half of what they own if their home flooded, burned, or got broken into tonight. It matters for many reasons. Insurers want details: what it was, what brand, what it was worth. Without that, you leave money on the table.

So I built Room Inventory Bot on @Grok @Bot.

Here's how it works:

🏠 Name each room and snap a few photos (Bot tells you exactly how to shoot them)

💎 Point out your key items: jewelry, art, electronics, heirlooms

📋 It builds a full inventory with estimated values for every room

🖥️ You get a clean, designed HTML report and PDF to save and print

🔄 Buy something new or get rid of something? Send a new photo and it updates

Your information stays private. Nothing gets shared.

Good for:
✅ Insurance claims and checking your coverage
✅ Moving and spotting damage afterward
✅ Estate planning
✅ Rentals and renovations
✅ Simply knowing what you own

It takes about 10 minutes a room and could save you thousands.

Try it free 👇

LINK: https://x.ai/bot/EC3L23d7wESxjrEDJ2F1D
